## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and link the relevant issue.

## Changes

- What changed?
- What is deliberately excluded?

## Verification

List the commands and checks actually run, their results, and anything not verified.
Include API, worker, or browser evidence when the changed behavior requires it.

## Compatibility and Rollback

Describe migrations, stored-workflow compatibility, new configuration, and how to roll back.

## Checklist

- [ ] Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the Flowcordia contribution requirements.
- [ ] Kept the change focused and updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] Added appropriate tests and recorded their results.
- [ ] Preserved third-party licenses and attribution.
- [ ] Confirmed no secrets, private payloads, or local deployment files are included.
- [ ] Kept this PR in draft until required checks pass.
